title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source Dark Fiber Infrastructure
agency_path: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.USDA, DEPARTMENTAL ADMINISTRATION.USDA, OCP-POD-ACQ-MGMT-BRANCH-FTC
detail_text: In Accordance with FAR 5.101 The USDA intends to award a firm fixed price contract on a sole source basis to Iowa Communications Network The anticipated award will be made under the statutory authority permitting Other than Full and Open Competition, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.103-1 (b)(c)(i) Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The primary North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 517810. THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT, NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS. No solicitation is available.
